Name: switch_sun_to_son
Title: Switch Experiment Group from SU(N) to SO(N) and Compare to Baseline
Experiment: Modify experiment.py to replace SU(N) sampling with SO(N) sampling using QR decomposition with det=+1 correction. Preserve the existing output schema (final_info.json with a 'means' section of scalar metrics) so results remain comparable to the current SU(N) baseline in run_0. Compute analogous metrics for SO(N): determinant deviation from +1, orthogonality max deviation (||U^T U - I||_max), and Frobenius norms vs identity for a small set of generation scales (or equivalent). After running, update notes.txt to briefly compare SO(N) results against the SU(N) baseline means and highlight key differences.
